name: SIA 101 雷击 客舱起火

cards.audioText: B: You are encountering severe icing at FL390 and want lower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 FL390 遭遇严重结冰，想要更低高度。
cards.referenceText:
HongKong Control, SIA 101, we are
encountering severe icing at FL390, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，我们在 FL390 遭遇严重结冰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, descend to FL310, reach 310 within 4 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，下降至 FL310，4 分钟内到达 310。
cards.referenceText: Descend to FL310, reach FL310 within 4 minutes, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 FL310，4 分钟内到达 FL310，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, you observed lightning to your right and the aircraft was shaking, you suspect you have suffered lightning strike, tell ATC the situation and request 10 miles deviation to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，你观察到右侧有闪电且飞机晃动，你怀疑遭受雷击，告诉 ATC 情况，并请求向左偏航 10 海里。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA 101, we observed lightning to our right and the aircraft was shaking, we suspect we have suffered lightning strike, request 10 miles deviation to the left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，我们观察到右侧有闪电且飞机晃动，我们怀疑遭受雷击，请求向左偏航 10 海里。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, deviation 10 miles to the left is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，向左偏航 10 海里批准。
cards.referenceText: Deviation 10 miles to the left is approved, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向左偏航 10 海里批准，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now the purser reports there is a strange smell coming from the rear cabin, tell ATC the situation and request further descent as precaution.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在乘务长报告后客舱有异味，告诉 ATC 情况，并作为预防请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA 101, the purser reports there is a strange smell coming from the rear cabin, request further descent as precaution.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，乘务长报告后客舱有异味，作为预防请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, continue descent to FL250.

C: SIA 101, are you carrying any dangerous cargo?
B: Tell ATC you are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，你是否载有危险货物？
B：告诉 ATC 你在后货舱载有一些易燃液体。
cards.referenceText: We are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们在后货舱载有一些易燃液体，SIA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, roger that.
B: Now smoke is coming out of the floor in the aft cabin, so you decide immediately to divert to HongKong. Declare an emergency and make a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，收到。
B：现在后客舱地板冒烟，所以你决定立即备降香港。宣布紧急并发出遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, HongKong Control, SIA 101, request immediately divert to HongKong due cabin fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，香港管制，SIA 101，因客舱火警，请求立即备降香港。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, roger your MAYDAY, fly heading 010 and descend to FL110.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，收到你的 MAYDAY，飞航向 010，下降至 FL110。
cards.referenceText: Fly heading 010 and descend to FL110, SIA 101.

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you may stop on the runway and evacuate passengers there.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你可能会停在跑道上并在那里疏散旅客。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA 101, we may stop on the runway and evacuate passengers there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，我们可能会停在跑道上并在那里疏散旅客。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, copy that, what kind of emergency services do you need?
B: Tell ATC you need fire service and medical service to be attendance near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，收到，你需要哪种应急服务？
B：告诉 ATC 你需要消防和医疗服务在跑道附近待命。
cards.referenceText: Request fire services and medical service to near the runway, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求消防和医疗服务到跑道附近，SIA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, fire and medical services, copy that.
B: After having discharged the fire extinguisher and applied the smoke procedure, the smoke is stopped and is controlled. Tell ATC your situation and cancel the Distress.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，消防和医疗服务，收到。
B：释放灭火瓶并执行烟雾程序后，烟雾停止并受控。告诉 ATC 你的情况并取消遇险。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA 101, the smoke is under control, cancel distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，烟雾已受控，取消遇险。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, roger, do you want to continue to HongKong?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at HongKong as a precaution.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，收到，你是否想继续飞往香港？
B：告诉 ATC 作为预防你仍需在香港落地。
cards.referenceText: We still need to land at HongKong as a precaution, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 作为预防，我们仍需在香港落地，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, descend to 4000 feet, heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，下降至 4000 英尺，航向 340 加入右三边，看到机场报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4000 feet, heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4000 英尺，航向 340 加入右三边，看到机场报告，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you need to park in a remote area and disembark the passengers there.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你需要停在远机位并在那里让旅客下机。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, SIA 101, we need to park in a remote area and disembark the passengers there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，SIA 101，我们需要停在远机位并在那里让旅客下机。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, we will relay your request to flight operations department.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，我们会将你的请求转告飞行运行部门。
